findings.title: Generic R3 PREMATURE_ABSENCE rule fires before condition mapping when routes=[]
findings.mechanism: scorer _score_critical applies the generic R3 absence rule before CRITICAL_CONDITION_MAP lookup; with no emitted routes the rule fires regardless of condition text
findings.measurement_effect: PARTIAL / absence observations after pseudo-route removal; principal driver of the 4 AUTHORITY_TRANSITION_CONFOUND P0s

findings.title: Free-text critical conditions absent from CRITICAL_CONDITION_MAP
findings.mechanism: the four P0 conditions are free-text and not present in the frozen condition map (scorer L33-41); deterministic lane cannot map them
findings.measurement_effect: condition-specific scoring unreachable; generic rule governs

findings.title: ROUT-069 null-condition representation handling
findings.mechanism: condition=null leads Wave-2 NO_CRITICAL_ERROR vs Wave-3 CRITICAL_ERROR under the same DETERMINISTIC owner; product semantics did not worsen (representation change)
findings.measurement_effect: P0-flagged transition driven by scorer sensitivity to null condition field

findings.title: Lexical label-vs-proposition matching in _score_routes
findings.mechanism: gold acceptable_routes are proposition sentences; scorer matches emitted labels lexically; SemanticJudgeStub.route_equivalent=false; across 39 entries: 0 exact matches, ~6 token-overlap cases
findings.measurement_effect: route PASS 0/108 remains unreachable regardless of product route quality until structured route evaluation exists
